entries.claim: The fix closes only the `include: []` shape. A policy with `coverage.include` missing or non-array (for example `{}`) still makes the gate exit 0 having checked no module.
entries.failure_scenario: I ran it. Policy {"coverage":{"lines":85,"branches":85,"statements":0}} (no include key), and the same with "include":{}, plus a valid report whose totals are 100/100 and whose files is {}. `!Array.isArray(include)` sends it down the fallback at lines 59-64. That runs the checker on the whole report, and the checker defaults include to [] (coverage-report-check.mjs:72) and skips its file checks. Output was 'lines: 100.00% meets 85 / branches: 100.00% meets 85', exit 0, with no per-module check and no 'no module was checked' failure. Any module below the floor stays green as long as the report totals pass. The new `include.length === 0` guard at line 69 is never reached for these inputs. Other shapes fail: include:null and include:"app/gate.py" both exit 1.
